'''SoroSuub Transport Systems''' was a subsidiary of [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] specializing in the creation of [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Their best known product was the [[Nyubba-class cargo barge driver|''Nyubba''-class cargo barge driver]].
